graph_decision.double_counting_rationale_for_review: Each assessed input is proposed as usage=both (CPT-estimation context + hard observation). Rationale for review: conditioning once in Bayes rule is a single update, not double counting; the LLM conditions table estimates on the patient's context while inference instantiates the same observed states as evidence. Optional missing inputs use estimation context only (the gap is noted in the conditioning context) with no hard evidence, so no update occurs on an unobserved node. DystoniaInvolvementSeverity (anatomical extent) and AirwayConcern (airway-compromise judgment) partly share the effect-severity source field by design: breathing/stridor severity is sufficient but not necessary for AirwayConcern present, and the proposed airway field can establish or (when non-breathing) complete it. They are distinct clinical facts with a single Bayes update each. Owner to accept or restrict any mapping to observation-only.

AcuteDystoniaReviewPathway (5 states; parents in order AirwayConcern, AcuteDystoniaEpisodePhase, AcuteDystoniaAntipsychoticAssociation, DystoniaInvolvementSeverity)
AnticholinergicSafetyReviewFocus (4 states; parents AnticholinergicSafetyConcern, OlderAgeVulnerability, OtherAnticholinergicBurden)
graph_decision.why_this_shape: One pathway node over airway, phase, association, and involvement plus three parallel review nodes for anticholinergic safety, post-resolution continuation, and antipsychotic regimen, mirroring BN-11's parallel-output structure at an executable size (836 cells). Twelve BN-11 node names and all output states are retained verbatim (snake_cased); unknown_incomplete is added to every 2-state BN-11 input except the two required nodes so optional missingness stays visible instead of blocking. BN-11 NoEpisode is folded into the gate (absent yields not_applicable) with the two never-dominant output states retained and flagged in Q4. No dose, product, threshold, prophylaxis, or detention node exists. All discrete nature nodes for the v1 execution profile; no latent nodes, no posterior chaining into other questions.

output_meanings.assess_episode_and_differential: Review prompt: association not established or phase/context unknown; assess medication timeline, distribution/persistence, and exclusions before any anticholinergic discussion. No treatment prompt from this branch.
output_meanings.consider_short_term_prevention_review: Review prompt: resolved associated episode with prevention need and no recorded patient concern; review short-term prevention with stopping conditions. Not routine prophylaxis and not a product/dose choice.
output_meanings.establish_episode_association: Review prompt: resolved episode whose antipsychotic association is not established or still unknown; establish association before any prevention discussion.
output_meanings.no_acute_treatment_rule: Retained source-draft state with no dominant v0.1 reference row (NoEpisode folded into the gate); carries no rule and is not a safety clearance. Owner direction requested in Q4.
output_meanings.no_episode_specific_review: Retained source-draft state with no dominant v0.1 reference row; the regimen posterior still always renders alongside the pathway branch. Owner direction requested in Q4.
output_meanings.not_post_resolution_review: Parallel prompt: episode active or phase unknown, so no post-resolution prevention review applies now.
output_meanings.post_resolution_review: Review prompt: recently resolved associated episode; review short-term prevention, patient concerns, stopping conditions, and causative-regimen review. Never a product/dose/route/duration selection.
output_meanings.review_acute_anticholinergic_treatment: Review prompt: active episode associated with antipsychotic therapy without airway concern; review acute anticholinergic treatment per current local labeling with patient-specific safety review. Not a prescription, product choice, dose, or administration order.
output_meanings.review_age_or_medication_burden: Parallel prompt: no patient-specific concern recorded but age vulnerability or concomitant burden (or unknown detail) is recorded; review that burden explicitly.
output_meanings.review_concern: Parallel prompt: safety-concern assessment itself is incomplete; assess the concern with disclosure.
output_meanings.review_concern_and_burden: Parallel prompt: patient-specific anticholinergic concern recorded; review it together with age vulnerability and concomitant burden.
output_meanings.review_dose_or_alternative: Parallel prompt: associated episode recorded; review possible dose reduction or a lower-risk alternative per current labeling. Never delays acute management; records no dose, product, or threshold.
output_meanings.review_need_and_patient_concerns: Review prompt: resolved associated episode with prevention need and recorded patient concern, or with need still unknown; review need and concerns together.
output_meanings.review_stopping_or_avoiding_unneeded_con: Review prompt: resolved associated episode with no prevention need recorded; review stopping or avoiding unneeded continuation. Not an instruction to discontinue.
output_meanings.routine_individualized_review: Parallel prompt: no concern, age vulnerability, or burden recorded; continue individualized review. Not a safety clearance.
output_meanings.urgent_airway_assessment: Review prompt plus deterministic flag: recorded airway concern takes priority over every other review regardless of diagnostic status.

question_enumeration.proposed_time_horizon: Current encounter (no outcome prediction horizon). Recent-episode linkage is retained separately per BN-11; the weeks-to-months prevention-reassessment course is a parallel review prompt, not a timed prediction.
question_enumeration.specific_question: For an adult follow-up encounter whose acute dystonia effect status is recorded as present, given current involvement severity, airway concern, episode phase, antipsychotic association (with onset, medication, and exclusion context), anticholinergic safety concern, age vulnerability, concomitant burden, recurrence-prevention need, and continuation preference concern, what is the posterior distribution over acute-dystonia review prompts (urgent airway assessment vs acute anticholinergic treatment review vs episode/differential assessment vs post-resolution review), with parallel anticholinergic-safety, continuation, and regimen review prompts, to structure physician review?

reference_table_provenance.forbidden: No empirical probabilities were manufactured; no guideline evidence rating (1C) or criteria observation was converted into a probability.
reference_table_provenance.rule: Root references illustrative (DystoniaInvolvementSeverity [0.55,0.35,0.10]; AirwayConcern [0.08,0.92]; AcuteDystoniaEpisodePhase [0.70,0.20,0.10]; AcuteDystoniaAntipsychoticAssociation [0.65,0.20,0.15]; AnticholinergicSafetyConcern [0.25,0.60,0.15]; OlderAgeVulnerability [0.20,0.65,0.15]; OtherAnticholinergicBurden [0.30,0.55,0.15]; RecurrencePreventionNeed [0.40,0.40,0.20]; AnticholinergicContinuationPreferenceConcern [0.25,0.60,0.15]). Pathway rows from the documented mapping: airway present -> urgent [0.84,0.04,0.04,0.04,0.04] (27 rows); airway absent with breathing involvement -> assess (9 rows, unreachable in practice, documented); airway absent otherwise with active+established -> review (2 rows), active+other -> assess (4 rows), resolved+established -> post-resolution (2 rows), resolved+other -> assess (4 rows), unknown phase -> assess (6 rows). Safety rows: concern present -> concern_and_burden [0.82,0.06,0.06,0.06] (9 rows); concern unknown -> review_concern (9 rows); absent+absent+absent -> routine (1 row); absent otherwise -> age_or_burden (8 rows). Continuation rows mirror the BN-11 deterministic logic softly: active/unknown phase -> not_post_resolution (54 rows); resolved+unestablished/unknown association -> establish (18 rows); resolved+established with need present and concern present -> need_and_concerns (1 row), need present otherwise -> consider prevention (2 rows), need absent -> stopping review (3 rows), need unknown -> need_and_concerns (3 rows). Regimen rows: active/resolved+established -> review_dose_or_alternative [0.88,0.06,0.06] (2 rows); otherwise assess_medication_association (7 rows). Lookup exists only to give the validator/inference harness complete, normalized, correctly ordered tables. Never present these as patient estimates.

source_classification.drafting_lead: BN-11 is an incomplete, inference-disabled and deployment-disabled drafting lead, not an approved mapping. Its four deterministic 0/1 review tables and eight missing root priors were replaced with soft argmax-preserving placeholders; no BN-11 activation metadata was copied.
source_classification.proposed_for_review: Agent-proposed graph, states, transforms, horizons, wording, and reference values; not source-derived clinical rules.
source_classification.source_derived: Statements reproduced or conservatively constrained from the cited sources without adding a clinical threshold or converting evidence grades into probabilities.

source_comparison.bn11_note_on_property_paths: BN-11 PROPERTY source_path values (medical-knowledge/02-md/STATEMENT-11.md) are stale relative to the current tree (docs/medical-docs/guideline/STATEMENT-11.md); the sha256 recorded in BN-11 matches the current STATEMENT-11 file, so content identity holds despite the path drift.
source_comparison.bn11_scope_vs_f4: BN-11 is a 12-node review-workflow draft (8 clinician inputs with missing priors + 4 deterministic 0/1 review outputs) with inference_allowed=false and deployment_allowed=false. F4 keeps its full input vocabulary and all four parallel-review outputs but restructures them into a 13-node executable network: 9 roots + 4 outputs with 13 GIVEN edges. The one added node is DystoniaInvolvementSeverity, which mirrors the FR-21 severity enum so extent stays explicit; unknown_incomplete is added to every 2-state BN-11 input except the two required nodes so optional missingness stays visible instead of blocking; BN-11 NoEpisode is folded into the gate (absent yields not_applicable). All four BN-11 deterministic 0/1 tables were replaced with soft argmax-preserving synthetic placeholders; no BN-11 TABLE bytes, priors, or inference/deployment flags were copied.
source_comparison.cdss_restriction_recorded: STATEMENT-11 Quality Measurement Considerations explicitly states this statement is not appropriate for electronic clinical decision support or quality measurement. X-INSIGHT is electronic decision support, so this is a substantive scope conflict recorded for owner resolution in Q5; the network properties, prompt, and template carry the restriction until resolved.
source_comparison.criteria_reuse: Sustained contractions/abnormal postures, days-scale onset (initiation, rapid escalation, preventive anti-EPS reduction), throat-muscle speech/swallowing/breathing involvement, medication timeline (antipsychotics, dopamine-blocking antiemetics, preventive anticholinergic changes), distribution/persistence review, and the catatonia/neurological/tardive exclusions with preceding-symptom and focal-finding investigation triggers are constituents of the proposed association field; none is encoded as a network gate or probability. The emergency rule (stridor/breathing difficulty as possible laryngeal dystonia; never delay airway evaluation for a checklist) is the deterministic urgent flag, not a posterior.
source_comparison.dissent_recorded: One writing-group member preferred dose reduction or switch over immediate anticholinergic use in some situations, and one flagged diphenhydramine naming; both are preserved as template regimen-review wording and owner question Q6, not as network states.
source_comparison.history_reuse: FR-21 status/severity mechanics are reused as the gate plus DystoniaInvolvementSeverity/AirwayConcern mappings; the history draft's mapping gaps (unresolved-vs-not_assessed, effect-specific inputs) are resolved here by separate proposed association/phase/airway/safety/burden/need/preference fields, each unknown-permitting except the two required inputs.
source_comparison.severity_reuse: The three-state involvement enum follows the history-effects draft proposal (itself following the criteria airway distinction), which remains awaiting_review and therefore unapproved; F4 treats it as a candidate mapping and flags the approval dependency in Q1.
source_comparison.statement11_content: STATEMENT-11 is a 1C recommendation for anticholinergic treatment of acute dystonia associated with antipsychotic therapy: rapid relief, laryngeal dystonia as lifesaving indication, short-term oral continuation until dose reduction or switch to a less-associated agent, lowest effective exposure for the shortest needed time, harms (dry mouth, blurred vision, glaucoma precipitation, constipation, tachycardia, urinary retention, thermoregulation, cognition, toxicity; greater in older patients and with concomitant burden), frightened/cooperative presentation with side-effect concerns, benefits far outweighing harms short-term with unclear long-term balance, and WFSBP/BAP agreement on individualized use. Product, dose, route, and duration content is background for physician label review only and contributes no network node or probability.
